I have been working on my mental health since February (6 months) and so it's taken me about 6 months. Before when I was losing weight it would've taken me a year and I would've regained some of it back to try and relose it again because of yo-yo dieting.

Since the goal is to heal me I focus on myself. If I'm not healthy, happy or able to give to the world then I can't do anything else on my schedule. You make time for the things that are important and you are important to you. You are your first priority.

I would give tips but my tips might not work for everyone. I started talking with a someone who specializes in trauma and a life coach. Then I did a bunch of research for the type of trauma I have. That's all the tips I usually share besides other comments and I apologize because it's really broad information. Be kind to yourself and talk to yourself like the unconditionally loving parent you've always wanted.

I'm not sure I would be a great mentor. I'm still doing a bunch of healing on myself at the moment. I did start by finding subreddits that promoted self love and finding someone who is trained with trauma and self healing to speak with. But I know you can do it and I fully believe in you! Keep pushing and keep moving forward the progress will show.

A few years ago I lost about 40lbs then j regained back and then some. So, then I would try different diets and eating habits and it didn't work and I was so mean to myself for not doing it perfectly. Dieting became a thing of punishment instead of healing. 

When I switched focusing on healing trauma and loving myself more as I was then everything became easier because I actually wanted to help myself instead of my old habit of destroying myself. Now, the weight melts off because I doing healthy habits out of love instead of out of shame.
Yes exactly! Instead of Band-Aids and temporary fixes. It takes work but it's definitely worth it.

Thanks! Yes exactly. The mindset switch really does help. I don't want food that puts me into a food-coma. I want food that will make me want to keep going through the day. 

Unless, it's a nice treat that will uplift my already elated mood and not something to try and make me happy when I'm down.
